Nothing is checked for the right-hand branch of the page: blood on dipstick with Schistosoma ova on microscopy / bilharzia risk, which the page resolves to 'Schistosomiasis likely'. The check_for list matches the left-hand branch faithfully.

The page puts 'uncomplicated pyelonephritis likely' under 'not needing urgent attention', i.e. flank pain with leucocytes/nitrites and none of the complicating features (vomiting, BP < 90/60, pulse ≥ 100, diabetes, male, pregnant, post menopause). The rule has no exclusion of those features, so it also fires for every complicated case. Because both rules diagnose the same concept the practical effect is small, but the rule is not faithful to the page's branching.
